finalText:
The culprit is **premature rounding after applying the percent discount**. The engine was rounding each coupon's result to 2 decimals immediately, losing precision. Then when converting to non-USD currencies, that tiny lost amount got multiplied by the exchange rate.

Here's what happened with a $19.98 order at 10% off, converted to GBP (rate 0.78):

**Buggy:** $19.98 → round($17.982 to 2 decimals) → $17.98 → convert → $14.0244 → rounds to $14.02

**Correct:** $19.98 → $17.982 → convert → $14.02596 → rounds to $14.03

The fix removes the two intermediate `round()` calls on lines 24 and 27 of engine.js. Now the engine applies all discounts at full precision, then rounds exactly once at the very end. All 40 tests pass.
